sections.title: Is Alcohol Addictive?
body: One of the factors that make alcohol addictive is the impact that it has on our brains. When we drink alcohol, our brain releases a neurotransmitter called Dopamine. Dopamine is a naturally occurring chemical in our brain that is associated with pleasure. When we engage in enjoyable activities, the positive feelings we experience are from Dopamine.
When it comes to alcohol and drugs, the impact on the reward system feels good, so we are more likely to engage in the same behavior to have the same experience.

sections.title: How Does Alcohol Impact the Brain?
body: Alcohol interferes with our brain’s ability to send messages between our neurons. This is what impacts our coordination, breathing, and speech. To compensate for the interference, our brain will release more neurotransmitters than it usually does. When alcohol is no longer in a person’s body, the brain is still sending more neurotransmitters than usual. Having too many neurotransmitters in our brains is what leads to withdrawal symptoms.
